comment:
* Represents the basic Preference UI building * block displayed by a {@link PreferenceFragmentCompat} in the form of a * {@link android.support.v7.widget.RecyclerView}. This class provides data for the * {@link android.view.View} to be displayed * in the list and associates with a {@link SharedPreferences} to * store/retrieve the preference data. *

* When specifying a preference hierarchy in XML, each element can point to a * subclass of {@link Preference}, similar to the view hierarchy and layouts. *

* This class contains a {@code key} that will be used as the key into the * {@link SharedPreferences}. It is up to the subclass to decide how to store * the value. * *

*

Developer Guides

*

For information about building a settings UI with Preferences, * read the Settings * guide.

*
